title: Road Accident Victims Compensation Law, 5735-1975
title_he: חוק פיצויים לנפגעי תאונות דרכים, תשל״ה–1975
source_id: Sefer HaChukim 5735 (ס״ח תשל״ה), p 234; Wikisource page: חוק פיצויים לנפגעי תאונות דרכים
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק פיצויים לנפגעי תאונות דרכים; the heading prints the title as חוק פיצויים לנפגעי תאונות דרכים, תשל״ה–1975 (note: printed without the definite-article prefix ה before תשל״ה, unlike the later Laws in this file — recorded as printed). Header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשל״ה, 234|חוק פיצויים לנפגעי תאונות דרכים|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/8/law/8_lsr_209261.pdf}}. Commencement 1 Tishrei 5737 (25 September 1976). The Law establishes the statutory compensation fund (קרן לפיצוי נפגעי תאונות דרכים) as a legal person, which is operative. Highest-year amendment box is ס״ח תשפ״ד, 1491 (Amendment No 13 to the Protection of Privacy Law), https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_4810658.pdf. Consolidation last edited 16 December 2025.
notes: The no-fault strict-liability regime for personal injury in a road accident: it displaces tort claims for bodily injury, caps and structures heads of damage, and routes uninsured/untraced cases to the Karnit fund. It is the second statute a person with an Israeli insurance claim is actually governed by, so it belongs next to the Insurance Contract Law. A human should decide whether the compulsory-insurance side, פקודת ביטוח רכב מנועי [נוסח חדש], תש״ל–1970 (Motor Vehicle Insurance Ordinance [New Version]) — a Mandate-derived Ordinance in New Version form — should be added as a third Act; it was NOT fetched or verified in this pass and must be checked against the register before being relied on.
